title: When Is the Right Time to Collect Fruits and Vegetables?
content: Fruits and vegetables should be collected when they are young or when they reach the proper maturity stage for consumption.

title: What Should Be Done If Fruit Growth Is Slow?
content: If fruit growth is slow, ensure proper watering and apply adequate fertilizer to support healthy development.

title: How Much Can Yield Increase Through Artificial Pollination?
content: Artificial pollination can increase crop yield by approximately 30–35 percent in rooftop gardening.

title: How Much Does Yield Decrease Without Artificial Pollination?
content: If artificial pollination is not done and natural pollination is absent, crop yield can decrease by 30-40 percent.

title: How Does Low Natural Pollination Affect Crop Yield?
content: When natural pollination is low, crop yield can decrease by up to 30-40 percent in rooftop gardens.

title: What Are the Proper Rules for Collecting Fruits?
content: Each young or ripe fruit should be collected separately and on a regular basis to maintain plant health and yield.

title: What Other Methods Help Increase Crop Yield?
content: Moderate watering, proper fertilizer application, and effective weed and insect control help increase crop yield.

title: How Should Plants Be Prepared After Harvesting Fruits?
content: After harvesting fruits, the plant should be kept clean, disease-free, and supplied with adequate soil moisture.

title: Why Should Fruits Be Harvested at a Young Stage?
content: Harvesting fruits at a young stage allows rapid growth of new fruits and creates space for new flowers.

title: Should Overripe Fruits Be Harvested All at Once?
content: Overripe fruits should not be harvested all at once; gradual harvesting helps reduce plant damage.

title: How Should Fruits Be Stored After Harvesting?
content: Fruits should be stored in a cool, dark, and clean place to maintain freshness and quality.

title: What Should Be Done If Young Fruits Fall Prematurely?
content: If young fruits fall, ensure adequate watering and apply proper fertilizer to reduce plant stress.

title: How Can Insects Be Controlled During Fruit Harvesting?
content: Insects can be reduced during fruit harvesting by using sticky traps, pheromone traps, and regular plant monitoring.

title: Which Fruits Should Be Harvested First?
content: Fruits that are fully ripe and have reached the proper size should be harvested first.

title: Can Trees Be Injured During Fruit Harvesting?
content: Trees can be injured during harvesting if seedlings or branches are broken, so fruits should be picked carefully.
